login.jhtml 302s to havanaone/login.htm; the QR canvas is the page's only canvas, rendered ~0.8s after doc start (qrCode/generate.do fires at ~0.17s) — no tab click needed, it sits beside the password/SMS form. Direct URL skips the 9.8s www.taobao.com front
cropped to the QR element — what the human scans (淘宝 App 扫一扫). qrCode/query.do polls scan state from ~0.8s automatically
on scan+confirm havana navigates off login.taobao.com (mid-login hops stay on that host, so this fires on the real landing). Cookie lands on .taobao.com — any taobao session can import it afterwards

logged-in landing evidence; redirectURL pins the landing to www.taobao.com so the nick anchor is meaningful there (nick:true = logged in, false = landed elsewhere or logged out — re-check on www before retrying; do NOT probe i.taobao.com my_taobao: no nick anchor on that page + bounces to havana = false negative, 2026-10-07 watch lesson).
